extracted.name: Broccoli Slaw
extracted.description: This crunchy broccoli slaw is made with broccoli coleslaw mix, almonds, and raisins tossed in a sweet and tangy dressing for a refreshing side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 (3 ounce) packages chicken ramen noodles, broken
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, sugar, vinegar, and ramen noodle seasoning packets together in a small bowl.
Combine broccoli coleslaw mix, broken ramen noodles, almonds, raisins, green onions, and green bell pepper together in a salad bowl; fold in dressing.
